## RegisteredOperation interface

One operation the runtime can invoke.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface RegisteredOperation
```

## Remarks

Pairs the descriptor callers address with the manifest-side facts the pipeline enforces: the risk class governance evaluates, and the permission history that explains a denial after a permission was renamed.
